title: 非递增顺序的最小子序列
summary: 选择长度最短的子序列，使其元素和严格大于未选元素和，并按非递增顺序返回。
insight: 为用最少元素达到超过一半总和，应贪心选择最大元素；降序累加直到 selected>total-selected。
pitfalls: 相同最短长度下选择总和最大的方案

solutions.title: 降序前缀贪心
solutions.idea: 取排序后能超过剩余和的最短前缀。
steps: nums 升序排序并计算 total
从末尾向前加入 answer、更新 selected

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> minSubsequence(int[] nums){Arrays.sort(nums);int total=Arrays.stream(nums).sum(),selected=0;List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=nums.length-1;i>=0;i--){answer.add(nums[i]);selected+=nums[i];if(selected>total-selected)break;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSubsequence(nums:IntArray):List<Int>{nums.sort();val total=nums.sum();var selected=0;val answer=mutableListOf<Int>();for(i in nums.lastIndex downTo 0){answer.add(nums[i]);selected+=nums[i];if(selected>total-selected)break};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> minSubsequence(vector<int>& nums){sort(nums.begin(),nums.end());int total=accumulate(nums.begin(),nums.end(),0),selected=0;vector<int> answer;for(int i=nums.size()-1;i>=0;--i){answer.push_back(nums[i]);selected+=nums[i];if(selected>total-selected)break;}return answer;} };
